item.tib: rig 'dzin thugs kyi rtsa rgyud drag gcod nyams su blang thabs las rgyun khyer nyams su blang thabs 'od ldan li yi me long
item.coloph: 'di ni gnyan sa ri 'grims gyi gcod (spyod) tshul du gcod pa'i nyams len thabs rdzogs pa'o/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gtsugs (gtsug) pad 'byung gi/ rnam grol 'gro la brtse ba'i mi shig pa/ yongs srid bA+e ro mngon byon sangs rgyas gling / g.yu sgra'i snang bsnyan (brnyan) g.yung drung bstan 'dzin thabs gnyis thugs rje'i byin rlabs snying dbus thob ma'i tshul/ thos bsam nyams len med pa'i zob rdzun can/ rang gzhan mang por phan pa sgrabs (bsgrab) pa'i thabs/ sngon chad mig yul gyur (pa) lag len rgyu/ ma lon ne'u tso'i smra ba ltar bsgrubs 'd-i/ sbur ma rlung gi (gis) bskyod ltar rang dbang dang / mi ldan bdag la bde ba'i gtad so ci/ 'on kyang rgyal 'phags bka' la bslu med bsnyams (snyam) / rje rin po g.yung drung bstan 'dzin de nyid kyis zhabs rdul spyi bor blangs pa'i snyoms (snyom) las pa badz+nyA na hri d+ha'i ngag tu son te yi ge pa prany+dza shI la'i (las) 'brug lor zla ba dang por g.yung drung dpal gyi gdan sa sgrubs (sgrub) khang dbus (dbu'i) rtser 'grub so (grub) bo//
